latency_model.rationale: Prefill cost scales linearly with sequence length; saved_prefix_tokens/total_prompt_tokens gives a conservative lower bound on wall-clock latency reduction for the prefill phase.

measured_latency.note: Phase 1 uses unique system prompts (no KV cache benefit); Phase 2 uses the identical system prompt for all requests (cache populated on first hit, reused by subsequent 99). The near-zero measured reduction indicates the gateway-level prefix trie does not currently skip GPU prefill computation — it tracks token overlap but does not yet feed saved KV states back into the MLX attention kernel.
